title: Heart Bowl of Fruit
description: A surreal painting shows a black stemmed glass bowl filled with shiny red apples and striped green melons, positioned inside a large dripping heart made of deep red petals. Black liquid drips from the bowl and heart onto a colorful paint-splattered surface below, with two fallen fruits resting at the base.
prompt: surreal still life painting of a black stemmed glass bowl overflowing with shiny red apples and striped green melons, the bowl is nestled inside a large heart shape made of dark red dripping flower petals, black viscous liquid drips heavily from the bowl and heart, two fallen fruits on the ground, vibrant colorful paint splatters and drips throughout the scene, dramatic light rays from top right, expressive watercolor style with bold color contrasts
